source.entry: 2026-09-18 — four workers stalled starting a server on a CLI that cannot hold one
source.quote: Pass `needs_server: true` to `spawn_worker` whenever the task starts a dev server, a daemon or a browser, including evidence and screenshot capture; the dispatch then skips every harness that cannot keep such a process alive, and refuses a forced one with the reason.

input: [repo: webapp] Add a "Copy link" button to the footer of the share dialog in src/components/ShareDialog.tsx, to the left of the existing "Close" button. It copies the dialog's share URL to the clipboard and shows the existing "Link copied" toast. As evidence, take a Playwright screenshot of the open dialog at 1280px wide, running against the dev server. The button uses the same secondary style as Close; if the clipboard write fails, nothing is shown. `pnpm dev --port <n>` serves the app with the mocked login the repo ships, so no backend, VPN or account is needed, and the screenshot goes to a path outside the repository that the worker reports.

reply.verification: runs verify command `pnpm test` in the bead's worktree after the worker ends

reply.title: Copy link button in the share dialog footer
